nova.name: Nova-Seeds · Proof Bloom
nova.description: Give a visionary claim a falsifiable boundary. Grow a capability only after its evidence survives review.
nova.objective: Find a better allocation of laboratory resources, then test whether its advantage survives higher costs.
nova.claim: A Nova-Seed could accelerate scientific discovery and create lasting value.

mission.goal: Maximize modeled experiment value under the laboratory budget and risk constraints.

sovereign.name: Sovereign Bloom Engine
sovereign.description: Compile the objective into native Missions, local JobSpec plans and a complete ProofBundle return path.
sovereign.objective: Improve a production schedule and demonstrate that its advantage persists when operations slow down.
sovereign.claim: A reusable coordination capability could make industrial systems more resilient.

mission.goal: Reduce sample job-shop makespan without violating machine capacity or operation precedence.

omega.name: Alpha Business · Ω-Lattice
omega.description: Compare a portfolio of modeled businesses, expose the assumptions and carry only reviewed computation into the lattice.
omega.objective: Allocate a bounded pilot budget across candidate businesses and stress their operating costs.
omega.claim: An Alpha-Factory could turn underused resources into compounding cash flows.

mission.goal: Choose the highest modeled contribution under an explicit pilot budget and risk cap.

invention.name: Invention Automation Machine
invention.description: Select a forecasting policy on training data, measure untouched holdout error and reuse the exact reviewed benchmark in a harder mission.
invention.objective: Test a demand forecasting policy against a last-value baseline and challenge it with an alternating demand shock.
invention.claim: Each validated invention could become useful leverage for the next.

mission.goal: Select the forecasting policy using training data alone and measure separate holdout error.

proof.name: Proof Debt → AGI Jobs
proof.description: Bring an unsupported draft or an Insight Atlas research Mission. Convert its evidence gap into explicit work and exact, reviewable quotations.
proof.objective: Separate the pilot's measured results from claims that still require real-world validation.
proof.claim: The pilot is ready for reliable, profitable production deployment.

mission.goal: Find measured pilot outcomes, missing evidence, production reliability limits and cost assumptions.

sources.title: Illustrative pilot register
sources.text: The pilot processed 120 requests over one week. Nine requests required manual review. No long-term production reliability result was established.

sources.title: Illustrative cost register
sources.text: Measured compute cost was 24 planning units in this sample. Review time was not measured. Revenue was not observed. Production profitability remains an unsupported claim.
